Menace (This creature can’t be blocked except by two or more creatures.)

T: Rigwarl deals 1 damage to target creature you control.

Deathtouch

Vigilance, haste

First strike

Whenever Chaos Knight attacks, roll a d6. Knights you control get +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is the result.
flavor: “Fall to your knees and lament.”

name: Chen, the Holy Knight
rules:
Vigilance
When Chen enters, return target nonlegendary creature from your graveyard to your hand.
flavor: “I have left the dark desert of my past to walk now in the light of Obelis.”

flavor: With the proper focus, Anti-Mage turns innate resistance into calculated retaliation.

Reach, haste

rules:
Vigilance

flavor: “I’ve a mind like a steel trap, and the physique to go with it!”

name: Rylai, the Crystal Maiden
rules:
When Rylai enters, tap up to one target creature an opponent controls. You may put a stun counter on it.  (If a permanent with a stun counter would become untapped, remove one from it instead.)
Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost 1 less to cast.
flavor: “Guess you didn’t know a little game of freeze tag could turn lethal.”

name: Ish'Kafel, the Dark Seer
rules: When Ish’Kafel enters, choose an opponent. For each creature they control, create a token that’s a copy of that creature.
flavor: “Your life, much like your head, lacked a point.”

name: Mireska, the Dark Willow
rules:
Flying
When Mireska enters, target opponent becomes the monarch.
Whenever an opponent draws a card except the first one they draw in each of their draw steps, they lose 1 life.
flavor: “A little mischief never killed anyone... well, you I guess.”

name: Valora, the Dawnbreaker
rules:
Flash (You may cast this spell any time you could cast an instant.)
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for 1 or one mana of that creature’s color.)
Lifelink
When Valora enters, prevent all damage that would be dealt to you and creatures you control this turn.
flavor: “My powers, like my life, were given to me. The will to wield them justly I found on my own.”

name: Aghanim’s Sceptre
rules:
T: Add WUBRG. Spend this mana only to cast legendary spells.
Whenever you cast a legendary spell, you may draw a card.
flavor: The scepter of a wizard with demigod-like powers.

rules:

B, T: Put a -1/-1 counter on target creature.
flavor: “Where my shadow falls, there falls my foe.”

Flying

T, 1: Copy target instant or sorcery spell you control. You may choose new targets for the copy.

rules:
Devour 1 (As this enters, you may sacrifice any number of creatures. This creature enters with that many +1/+1 counters on it.)
If a nonlegendary creature would die, exile it with a void counter on it instead.
Lucifer has all abilities of creatures exiled with void counters on them.
flavor: “I am the midnight of your soul.”

name: Doom
rules: Choose target creature an opponent controls. It loses all abilities until end of turn. Destroy it.
flavor: When a name is tolled from the bell of Vashundol, Doom is sure to follow.

rules:
When Kaolin enters, create three artifact tokens called Stone Remnant (They have no abilities).

flavor: “Through conflict, one’s nature is revealed.”

Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for 1 or one mana of that creature’s color.)

Trample

If a creature you control would deal excess combat damage to a player or planeswalker, it deals twice that much damage instead.
flavor: “There may be many earths, but there’s only one Earthshaker.”

Flying

flavor: “That which is fundamental cannot be destroyed.”

Haste

flavor: “Great honors await you in the Nothl Realm.”

Prowess

Flying

name: Overcharge
rules:
Target creature gets +1/+0 for each creature you control and gains first strike until end of turn.

You gain 2 life and draw a card.

name: Town Portal Scroll

When this artifact is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, draw a card.

flavor: Not one thrall creature of the depths, nor spirit bound in drowning’s keep, nor Maelrawn the Tentacular, shall rest till seas, gem comes to sleep.

rules:
Creatures your opponents control get -1/-1.
Whenever a creature dies, creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn.
flavor: Even being near Nevermore eats away at one’s soul.

flavor: A ring that feeds on the souls of those who wear it.

rules: T, Sacrifice Hand of Midas: Destroy target nonlegendary creature. You create X treasure tokens, where X is that creature’s mana value.
flavor: Preserved through unknown magical means, the Hand of Midas is a weapon of greed, sacrificing animals to line the owner’s pockets.

At the beginning of combat on your turn, if it is night, equipped creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn.

When a creature an opponent controls dies, put a charge counter on this artifact.

flavor: Contains the ashes of powerful demons—invigorating to some, and deadly to most.

Whenever a creature dies, put a charge counter on this artifact.
Equipped creature gets +X/+0, where X is the number of charge counters on this artifact.

rules:
This artifact enters with three charge counters on it.
T, Remove a charge counter from this artifact: Put a +1/+1 on target creature. It gains haste until end of turn.
flavor: A relic that enchants the bodies of those around it for swifter movement in times of crisis.

rules:
When Meepo enters, if it isn’t a token, create three tokens that are copies of it.
As long as Meepo is a token, it is not legendary.
1: Meepo phases out. (While it’s phased out, it’s treated as though it doesn’t exist. It phases in before its controller untaps during their next untap step.)
When Meepo leaves the battlefield, exile all other cards named Meepo, the Geomancer.
flavor: “I guess size ain’t everything, eh?”

name: Jakiro, the Twin Head Dragon
rules:
Flying, haste
Whenever Jakiro attacks, it deals 2 damage divided as you choose among up to two targets.
Whenever Jakiro attacks, tap up to one target permanent.
flavor: “Tis an honor to die by dragons.”

name: Yurnero, the Juggernaut
rules:
Hexproof (This creature can’t be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)

flavor: “There’s a fine line between bravery and stupidity.”

name: Ezalor, the Keeper of the Light
rules:
Vigilance
Whenever you cast a spell during an opponent’s turn, tap target creature an opponent controls.
flavor: “I’ll forego green girdles and questing beasts, for all such knightly trifles pale before the light.”

Vigilance

flavor: Mt. Joerlak was a somewhat unstable mass, and Magnus has learned to channel its reverberations.

name: Decay
rules: Put four -1/-1 counters on target creature you don’t control. Then, put four +1/+1 counters on target creature you control.
flavor: The strength of the living is simply borrowed from the strength of the dead.

name: Helm of the Dominator
rules:
You control equipped creature and it gets +2/+2.
4: Attach this equipment to target nonlegendary creature you don’t control. Activate only as a sorcery.
flavor: The powerful headpiece of a dead necromancer.

name: Ion Shell
rules:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets +X/+X, where X is the number of cards in your hand.
When this Aura enters the battlefield, draw a card.
flavor: “If your enemy is equal, prepare for him. If greater, elude him. If weaker, crush him.” — Ish’Kafel, the Dark Seer

name: Culling Blade
rules:
Culling Blade deals 5 damage to target opponent with 5 or less life.
Cycling 2 (2, Discard this card: Draw a card.)
flavor: “You get nothing. Good day, sir!” — Mogul Khan, the Axe

name: Chain Frost
rules:
(You may cast a legendary instant only if you control a legendary permanent)
Destroy each tapped creature your opponents control.

name: Provocative Comment
rules:
All creatures block target creature this turn if able.
Draw a card.
flavor: “You want some of this, son, you want it?” — Rigwarl, the Bristleback

name: Lightning Bolt
rules: Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to any target.
flavor: “Your prayer, answered.” — Zeus, the Lord of Heaven

name: Smoke of Deceit
rules:
T, Sacrifice this artifact: Target creature you control gains “This creature can’t be blocked this turn”.
When this artifact leaves the battlefield, draw a card.
flavor: The charlatan wizard Myrddin’s only true contribution to the arcane arts.

name: Arc Lightning
rules: Arc Lightning deals 3 damage divided as you choose among one, two, or three targets.
flavor: “Ha ha ha ha ha. Well what did you expect?” — Zeus, the Lord of Heaven

name: Obvious Distraction
rules:
Target creature gets -3/-0 until end of turn.
Draw a card.
flavor: Meepo’s proficiency for diversion is bested only by his clumsiness.

name: Viscous Nasasl Goo
rules:
Enchant player
Whenever enchanted player takes damage, put a charge counter on this enchantment.
If enchanted player would take damage, instead enchanted player takes that much damage plus the number of charge counters on this enchantment.

name: Living Armor
rules:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each land you control.
flavor: “Come into my shade.” — Rooftrellen, the Treant Protector

name: Fountain of Rejuvenation
rules:
At the beginning of your upkeep, you gain 2 life.
T: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature. Activate only as a sorcery.
flavor: Basking in the Fountain is a short respite from the chaos of battle.

name: Walrus PUNCH!
rules: Exile target blocking creature. Creatures that were blocked by that creature this combat gain trample until end of turn.
flavor: It never matters who throws the first punch, only who throws the last.

name: Bramble Maze
rules: Whenever a creature attacks you, put a -1/-1 counter on it.
flavor: “You want me, come get me...” — Mireska, the Dark Willow

name: Shadow Walk
rules:
Target creature you control gains shadow until end of turn. (They can block or be blocked by only creatures with shadow).
Draw a card.
flavor: “You can’t fight what you can’t see.” — Gondar, the Bounty Hunter

name: Tandem Takedown
rules: Up to two target creatures you control get +1/+0 until end of turn. They each deal damage equal to their power to another target creature, planeswalker, or battle.
flavor: “Ready? One... Two... Three!” — Nattea, Centaur Courser

name: Light Strike Array
rules: Light Strike Array deals 5 damage to each opponent. Creatures those players control can’t block this turn.
flavor: “One little spark and before you know it, the whole world is burning.” — Lina, the Slayer

name: Enchant
rules:
Enchant nonlegendary creature
You control enchanted creature.
flavor: “Charmed, I’m sure!” —  Aiushtha, the Enchantress

name: Infernal Blade
rules:
Equipped creature has deathtouch.
Equip legendary creature 1.
flavor: “I stoke the furnace with your corpse.” — Lucifer, the Doom

name: Pounce
rules: Target creature you control fights target creature you don’t control. (Each deals damage equal to its power to the other.)
flavor: Time in the Dark Reef made Slark a dangerous assassin; aggressive and fearless.

name: Refraction
rules:
(You may cast a legendary instant only if you control a legendary permanent.)
Put X +1/+1 counters and X shield counters on target creature. (If it would be dealt damage or destroyed, remove a shield counter from it instead.)
flavor: “Another scale of ignorance shed.” — Lanaya, the Templar Assassin

name: Largo
rules:
Play with the top card of your library revealed.
As long as the revealed card is blue or an Island, creatures you control have hexproof and flying.
As long as the revealed card is red or a Mountain, creatures you control have first strike and haste.
As long as the revealed card is green or a Forest, creatures you control get +2/+2 and have trample.
flavor: “Hoo easy, mate. I’m gonna write a killer song about this.”

name: Starfall
rules:
It becomes night.
Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
Surveil 2. (Look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them into your graveyard and the rest on top of your library in any order.)
flavor: The Goddess breaks the strata to empower her Princess in the time of need.

name: Vale of Augury
rules:
(T: Add W, R, or G).
This land enters tapped.
4, T, Sacrifice this land: Draw a card.
flavor: Rootfallen and the Ent live in the mountains beyond the Vale, where the eldritch soil keeps them nourished.

name: Omexe Ambush
rules:
Choose one —
• Target creature you control gets +3/+3 and gains trample until end of turn.
• Target creature you control fights target creature you don’t control.
flavor: The Omexe archers are renowned for their ability to track targets through the Jungle with ease.

name: Sprout Treant
rules:
Create a 2/2 green Treant creature token.
Retrace (You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding a land card in addition to paying its other costs.)
flavor: Verodicia bestowed the Prophet with the ability to summon the Treant Guard, a mythical sentient army of the wild.

name: Gust
rules:
Put target noncreature spell on top of its owner’s library.
Draw a card.
flavor: Traxex is rather fond of the tranquility of physical combat, calling on her Drow heritage to end the incantations of opposing magi.

name: Conscript
rules: Exile target creature you don’t control. Create an X/X green and white Wolf Soldier creature token, where X is that creature’s toughness.
flavor: The Bronze Legion does not discriminate against any prisoners based on their race or kin, provided they know how to fight.

name: Roam the Jungle
rules:
Search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
If you control a legendary creature, search for two basic land cards instead.
flavor: To some, the Radiant Jungle is a battlefield, to others, it is home.

name: Stern Rebuttal
rules: Exile target instant or sorcery spell. Draw a card.
flavor: “I cast Magic aside” — Anti-Mage

name: Slack Off
rules:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature loses all abilities, isn’t legendary, and can’t attack or block.
flavor: Oftentimes, thought Krang, the siege wagons seemed to load themselves.

name: Helping Hand
rules:
Return target attacking or blocking creature you control to its owner’s hand.
Until end of turn it has flash and you may cast it without paying it’s mana cost. (You may cast this spell any time you could cast an instant.)
flavor: “I’ve got you!”

name: Ball of Creeps
rules:
Trample
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for 1 or one mana of that creature’s color.)
When Ball of Creeps enters the battlefield, exile each nonlegendary creature you control until Ball of Creeps leaves the battlefield.
Ball of Creeps gets +2/+2 for each creature exiled with it.
flavor: Some say you can hear the sound of gold dropping as it rolls.

name: Protect the Young
rules: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 for each creature you control and gains indestructible until end of turn.
flavor: Thunderhide migration is always discernible by an impending quake.

name: Bronze Hoplite
rules: First strike

name: Covet
rules: Gain control of target artifact an opponent controls.
flavor: “When do I get a turn?” “You’ve already had a turn!”  — Aggron Stonebreak, the Ogre Magi

name: Coup de Grace
rules: Destroy target creature an opponent controls.

name: Doppleganger
rules: Exile target creature you control. Create a token that’s a copy of that creature, except it isn’t legendary if the exiled creature was legendary. Return the exiled creature to the battlefield under your control at the beginning of the next end step.
flavor: Dread Magus Vorn’s death imbued the Phantom Lancer with the ability to blend with all spectrums of light.

name: Ravage
rules:
(You may cast a legendary sorcery only if you control a legendary permanent.)
Affinity for Islands (This spell costs 1 less to cast for each Island you control.)
Return all nonland permanents your opponents control to their owner’s hand.
flavor: Calling to the abyssal god Maelrawn has resulted in entire armadas being lost at sea.

name: Dragon Slave
rules: Create a 4/4 red dragon elemental creature token with haste.
flavor: In the scorched barren of Misrule, Lina learned to manipulate the fiery breath of the Desert Wyrm as a form of entertainment.

name: Black Grimoire
rules:
Whenever a creature an opponent controls dies, put a charge counter on Black Grimoire.
T, Sacrifice this artifact: You gain 1 life and draw a card for each charge counter on this artifact.

name: Solar Guardian
rules:
Creatures you control get +2/+2 until end of turn.
Draw a card.
flavor: Its much harder to hit someone with a sword with the sun in your eyes.

name: Overgrowth
rules:
Enchant land
Whenever enchanted land is tapped for mana, its controller adds an additional GG.
flavor: “Thoughts cross my mind as the sun crosses the sky.” — Rooftrellen, the Treant Protector

name: Bind to Earth
rules:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature loses flying. Prevent all combat damage enchanted creature deals.

name: Corner
rules:
Enchant creature
When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature.
Enchanted creature doesn’t untap as long as its power is 4 or less.
flavor: “It appears I’ve gotten myself into a pickle” — Kardel Sharpeye, the Sniper

name: Unyielding Spirit
rules: At the beginning of combat on your turn, put a +1/+1 counter on each nonlegendary creature you control.
flavor: Under fire, outnumbered, and surrounded, Torq never gave up hope.

name: Finesse
rules: Exile target artifact. Draw a card.
flavor: “Nothing to it Rikko, I told you!”
